defects.description: delete() leaves the note's owner entry and postings in place, so a deleted note is still returned by search.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import {Index} from "./src/index.js"; const i=new Index(); i.add("alice","a1","salary review"); i.delete("alice","a1"); console.log(JSON.stringify(i.search("alice","salary")));'

defects.why_missed: The suite only checks that delete refuses another owner's note; nothing searches after a successful delete.

defects.description: search() cuts the top k across all owners before keeping the principal's notes, so higher-scoring notes of other owners crowd the principal's own matches out.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import {Index} from "./src/index.js"; const i=new Index(); for (const n of [1,2,3]) i.add("bob","b"+n,"q4 forecast revenue"); i.add("alice","a1","q4 forecast"); console.log(JSON.stringify(i.search("alice","q4 forecast revenue")));'

defects.why_missed: The isolation test has one note per owner, so the cut never drops a principal's match; it proves no leak, not that the principal gets its k results.
